findings.evidence: EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean:183 `valenceNumber_chargeConj … = -valenceNumber f i Q2`; EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/PDF/Isospin.lean:214 `valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj … = valenceNumber f (Equiv.swap u d i) Q2`; a repo-wide grep for `valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` returns only its definition and the module docstring.
findings.fix: State the general lemma `valenceNumber_piPlus_eq_neg_swap (hC hI hb) (i) (Q2) : PDF.valenceNumber (F piPlus) i Q2 = -PDF.valenceNumber (F piPlus) (Equiv.swap u d i) Q2`, proved by `conv_lhs => rw [piPlus_eq_chargeConj_speciesIsospinConj hC hI hb]; rw [PDF.valenceNumber_chargeConj, PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj]`, and derive the two existing results from it at `i = d` (`Equiv.swap_apply_right`) and `i = s` (`swap u d s = s`, so `n_s = -n_s`).
findings.issue: `valenceNumber_piPlus_d_eq_neg_u` and `valenceNumber_piPlus_s_eq_zero` are two hand-written special cases of one general relation. From `piPlus_eq_chargeConj_speciesIsospinConj` plus `PDF.valenceNumber_chargeConj` and the PR's own `PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` one gets `valenceNumber (F piPlus) i Q2 = -valenceNumber (F piPlus) (Equiv.swap u d i) Q2` for every flavour; instead the proofs go back to `PDF.mellinMoment_congr` on the density equalities, and `valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` (added in this PR) is then used nowhere.

findings.evidence: EpsilonEridani/Particles/Meson/Basic.lean:425-449 — the proofs are `ext <;> simp only [projection lemmas, Equiv.swap_apply_self]` plus `linarith`, with no LightFlavor-specific input; roadmap MesonStructure/README.md:444-448 (§1.4, SU(3) relations between π⁺ and K⁺).
findings.fix: Define the general swap, e.g. `def swapFlavor [DecidableEq Flavor] (e : Flavor → ℝ) (i j : Flavor) (M : PseudoscalarMeson Flavor) : PseudoscalarMeson Flavor` with the charge shifted by `(e (swap i j M.valenceQuark) - e M.valenceQuark) - (e (swap i j M.valenceAntiquark) - e M.valenceAntiquark)`, prove the involution, the commutation with `chargeConj` and `isChargeConsistent_swapFlavor_iff` at that level, and keep `isospinConj := swapFlavor LightFlavor.charge u d` with `isospinConj_piPlus` as the LightFlavor specialisation; state the valence-model lemmas for a general flavour equiv.
findings.issue: `PseudoscalarMeson.isospinConj` is fixed to `LightFlavor`, to the pair `(u, d)` and to `LightFlavor.charge`, but nothing in it or in its lemma block uses any of those: `isospinConj_isospinConj`, `chargeConj_isospinConj` and `isChargeConsistent_isospinConj_iff` hold verbatim for any `Flavor` with `DecidableEq`, any `e : Flavor → ℝ` and any pair `i j`. The nearby sibling `isChargeConsistent_chargeConj_iff (e : Flavor → ℝ)` (line 281) is general in the charge function, so the new `isChargeConsistent_isospinConj_iff` is narrower than the theorem it mirrors; the same restriction then propagates to `isospinConj_valenceModelWeight` and `isospinConj_valenceModelPdf` (Meson/Pdf/Isospin.lean:100,109), whose charge-conjugation counterparts `chargeConj_valenceModelWeight`/`chargeConj_valenceModelPdf` (Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:304,347) are general over `Flavor`. The roadmap's §1.4 wants the same swap machinery for `(d, s)`.

summary: Two valence-number corollaries are proved by hand as special cases of a general relation that follows in one line from the PR's own new API, and the meson-level isospin conjugation is pinned to `LightFlavor` and `LightFlavor.charge` although every proof in its block is flavour- and charge-function-agnostic, unlike its charge-conjugation siblings.
